name: How much does professional topic cluster creation for AI SEO typically cost?

mainEntity.name: How much does professional topic cluster creation for AI SEO typically cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of professional topic cluster creation for AI SEO varies significantly based on the scope of work. Factors include the number of topic clusters, the depth of keyword and competitor research, the amount of new content required (pillar pages and cluster articles), and ongoing optimization efforts. A project might range from a few thousand dollars for a single, comprehensive cluster to tens of thousands for a large-scale strategy covering multiple pillars and extensive content development. Most agencies provide custom quotes after assessing your specific needs and goals.
